# A help center that tells you what to write next.

> A help center you host yourself: Markdown articles, typo-tolerant ranked search, helpful votes and a report of what visitors searched for and could not find. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the search in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
